sources.snippet: A CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) — specifically EfficientNet-B0 — fine-tuned on HAM10000, the standard dermatoscopic imaging benchmark for skin cancer diagnosis. Classifies a lesion image into one of seven diagnostic categories and flags the three that are malignant or pre-malignant.
